Card Q&A.a: It refers to the positions at 4 and to the right of it on your side.
Card Q&A.q: What positions on the memory gauge does "if you have 4 or less memory" refer to?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If you have 4 or less memory, gain 1 memory.
[End of Your Turn] By suspending this Tamer, you may use 1 Option card with the [TS] trait from your hand. For each memory your opponent has, reduce this effect's paid cost by 1.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
